reasons: Datadog redis.keys.expired counts keys removed by TTL expiry, but the candidate uses redis.keys.evicted, which counts keys removed by memory-pressure eviction. Different quantity.
The candidate silently drops the host-prefixed template variable ($host becomes host=~"$host" in Dash0), so the series set is not the same as the Datadog request.

No OTel metric for expired keys is in the provided definitions, so the correct outcome is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING unless an expired-keys metric is supplied; the translated outcome is wrong.
Unit {key} and sum aggregation match, but these do not rescue the wrong metric.
